OPENADMET CYP INHIBITION BLIND CHALLENGE

CYPMode

Time-dependent CYP inhibition and CYP3A4–ligand structures, predicted by models whose every addition passed a pre-registered gate.

TDI classification · CYP3A4 and CYP2D6Structure prediction · CYP3A4 · 20 ligands

Six of the 20 submitted poses, picked by hand: the circled nitrogen of each drawing is the one nearest the heme iron in the submitted structure, the dashed line in the viewer joins it to the iron, and all 20 poses pass the PoseBusters checks. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, hover an atom of the ligand or the heme to name it. Structures: wwPDB. Drawings: RDKit. Viewer: 3Dmol.js (BSD-3-Clause), bundled in this file; the page makes no request.
